## 2. FIRST-GLANCE TEST
The screen appears to offer: (1) an implicit presentation context ("slide 45"), (2) a technical concept diagram (SVM/kernels/QP scatter plot), (3) a slide-number reference. None of these are actions — it is an informational slide. The plot itself wins the eye by contrast, but what it is teaching is unclear within 3 seconds.

- The scatter plot clusters are visually separated and use high-contrast colors (black, magenta/cyan/green, blue, red) against white axes — legible at a glance inside the axes region.
- The slide number badge at top-right provides a clear locator within a deck.
